description: New Feature: Daily Rewards System (7-day cycle) with server-authoritative validation, DataStore persistence, and client UI popup.
steps: Step 1 - Create src/ServerScriptService/Services/DailyRewardService.lua: A new ModuleScript service following the same pattern as other services (singleton table, .init() function). Implementation: (a) DailyRewardService._dataService reference. (b) init(dataService) stores the reference. (c) REWARDS table defining the 7-day cycle: Day1={type='Coins',amount=500}, Day2={type='Diamonds',amount=50}, Day3={type='Boost',boostType='2xCoins',duration=1800}, Day4={type='Coins',amount=1000}, Day5={type='FreeEgg',eggType='PremiumEgg'}, Day6={type='Diamonds',amount=100}, Day7={type='Special',rewards={{type='Coins',amount=5000},{type='Diamonds',amount=500}}}. (d) claimDailyReward(player) function: gets player data, checks data.dailyRewards.lastClaimTimestamp and data.dailyRewards.currentDay. Uses os.time() and calculates UTC day boundaries. If a new UTC day has passed since last claim, allows claim. Increments currentDay (wraps back to 1 after 7). If more than 2 days missed, resets streak to day 1. Awards the reward. Returns {success=true, day=N, reward=rewardDef, nextClaimTime=timestamp}. (e) getDailyRewardStatus(player) function: returns {currentDay, canClaim, nextClaimTime, rewards=REWARDS} for the UI. (f) _awardReward(player, rewardDef) helper that calls CurrencyService.addCoins/addDiamonds or EggService for free hatch.

Step 2 - Add dailyRewards field to DataService.lua default data schema: Add to getDefaultData(): dailyRewards = { lastClaimTimestamp = 0, currentDay = 0 }. Also add it to the getClientData() function so clients can read their daily reward status.

Step 3 - Wire DailyRewardService in Main.server.lua: (a) Require DailyRewardService. (b) Call DailyRewardService.init(DataService, CurrencyService, EggService) after other services. (c) Add 'ClaimDailyReward' and 'GetDailyRewardStatus' to the remoteFunctions list. (d) Wire handlers: ClaimDailyReward calls DailyRewardService.claimDailyReward(player) with 5s cooldown. GetDailyRewardStatus calls DailyRewardService.getDailyRewardStatus(player). (e) Add a 'DailyRewardAvailable' RemoteEvent that fires to client on join if they can claim.
Step 4 - Add DailyRewardService to generate_rbxlx.py: Add 'DailyRewardService' to the service_names list in build_server_script_service().

Step 5 - Client UI for Daily Rewards in Main.client.lua: (a) Add WaitForChild refs for ClaimDailyReward RemoteFunction and GetDailyRewardStatus RemoteFunction and DailyRewardAvailable RemoteEvent. (b) On DailyRewardAvailable event or on initial load, call GetDailyRewardStatus. If canClaim is true, show a popup via uiController:showDailyRewardPopup(status). (c) The popup shows all 7 days with the current day highlighted, a 'Claim' button. On claim click, invoke ClaimDailyReward. On success, show reward animation and close popup.

Step 6 - Add showDailyRewardPopup to UIController.lua: Create a ScreenGui with a Frame showing 7 day slots (icons/labels for each day's reward), highlight the current claimable day, dim already-claimed days. Include a 'Claim!' button that fires the callback. Show reward name/amount. Close button. Auto-show on login when reward is available.
acceptance_criteria: claimDailyReward validates UTC day boundaries and prevents double-claiming
DataService default schema includes dailyRewards field
ClaimDailyReward and GetDailyRewardStatus RemoteFunctions are created and wired
Client shows daily reward popup on login when claimable
verification: Run: python -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('XML valid')"
findings: EggService uses hatchFree (not hatchEggFree) for free hatches. Python build uses python3 (not python). FEAT-004 can skip regeneration since .rbxlx is already up to date.
